Title: Azure Monitor for containers Prometheus integration is now generally available

Body.Content:
The popular Prometheus integration is now generally available. Azure Monitor can now scrape your Prometheus metrics and store them on your behalf, without you having to operate your own Prometheus collection and storage infrastructure. We also have new Grafana templates for you to visualize all the performance data collected from your Kubernetes clusters. 

Learn more about the  Prometheus integration and Grafana templates.
